operations.name: plugins
operations.summary: List/status or enable/disable installed plugins through the authenticated local host.

plugin.description: CLI plugin identifier, such as ynab-zip-importer; required for enable/disable. The YNAB CLI identifier preserves its existing host and saved-budget identity.

input.description: Explicit local CLI arguments. The connection profile supplies home, budget and environment.

output.description: JSON host/plugin/job projection or operation result.

operations.side_effects: Enable/disable applies supported live transitions and browser drains. Restart-required preflight saves a validated startup selection and returns restart_required: true; running plugins remain active until restart. List/status only reads metadata.
operations.permissions: Authenticated device-local CLI profile with home and explicit sandbox/production environment. Personal workspace only; not available through remote profiles.
operations.scope: Selected runtime home, permanent budget identity and environment. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Unavailable plugins, invalid selections, busy work and failed live transitions are rejected. Restart-required plugin selection is saved for the next startup.
Startup, TLS, authorization, storage or recovery failures return sanitized errors.
operations.retry: Never automatically replay failed commands. Inspect status and native recovery before explicitly retrying an uncertain operation.

id.description: Permanent UUID or the default workspace ID.

active.description: Whether this is the host startup budget.

operations.side_effects: Read-only; does not activate another ledger.
